summary: Round r1 (restricted network). All empirical items are pending. Post-harvest losses have no official Nepal series; the plan is a study-level register (FAO Food Loss and Waste platform, MoALD) by commodity and stage, with FAOSTAT food-balance losses as a residual cross-check only. Agricultural export values for cardamom, ginger, tea, coffee, lentils and medicinal plants come from Department of Customs trade books (Nepal FY) and are cross-checked with UN Comtrade mirror data (calendar year). Market-access barriers are to be documented from WTO SPS/ePing records, the WTO Trade Policy Review of Nepal (2025) and the government report, DGFT notifications, the Nepal-India Treaty of Trade and plant-quarantine records; news items are used only as pointers. Processing and cold-chain capacity will come from MoALD, DFTQC, the tea board and NSO establishment censuses. Several institutional URLs are from general knowledge and unverified.

findings.claim: Post-harvest losses for major perishables (vegetables, fruits incl. citrus, potato, tomato; also grain storage losses), percent of production by supply-chain stage.
findings.note: Requires `python -m src.cli leads --fetch` for the listed lead URLs, extraction of the named tables and ingest as observations in r2. No value recorded in r1 (restricted network; no numbers from snippets or memory). No single official series; FAO FLW database holds study-level estimates with differing methods (farm survey, expert estimate, modelled) - each recorded with method and year; FBS 'losses' is a residual and only a cross-check.

data_gaps: No official post-harvest loss series; study-level estimates to be located
Customs trade books after FY2079/80 not located
SPS notification/STC records for Nepal products not retrieved (ePing, SPS IMS URLs unverified)
Cold-storage inventory and capacity - no source located
TEPC, DFTQC, NPPO and tea-board URLs unverified

assumptions.text: A barrier counts as 'documented' only if a primary legal instrument, notification or official report records it; media reports are pointers.
Loss estimates from different methods are not averaged; ranges are reported with method labels.

challenges.text: Request catalog ids for Nepal Trade Information Portal, National Tea and Coffee Development Board, and MoICS (government TPR report); currently source_id null.

Indian import-side measures on Nepali agricultural goods (07B-L10, 07B-L11) overlap with 17A's DGFT watchlist; propose 17A own the Indian-measure register and 07B reference it to avoid duplicate observations.
Agricultural import and export HS extractions from the same customs book (07B-L01 = 21D's customs lead) should be ingested once and shared.

uncertainty: All pending. Loss estimates are expected to vary widely across studies and methods; export values differ between customs and mirror data because of FY/calendar-year timing, valuation and informal trade; barrier documentation depends on notification coverage and will under-record informal non-tariff barriers at border points.

loss_estimates.method: Register of study-level loss estimates by commodity x stage (harvest, storage, transport, market) with method, year, geography and source; no pooling across methods; FAOSTAT FBS losses as residual cross-check.

export_barrier_register.method: One entry per product x market x measure: measure type (SPS, TBT, quota/restriction, safeguard, rules of origin, lab-testing/certification gap), legal instrument id and date, source; export values for the product-market pair from customs (Nepal FY) and mirror data (calendar year).

processing_capacity.method: Inventory of cold storage (count, tonnes), packhouses, food-processing establishments (NEC 2018/CME), tea factories, dairy processing and accredited testing labs; distinguish public, cooperative and private capacity; utilisation where reported.
